The 2023 Ford F-150 Lariat is a full-size pickup truck that blends advanced hybrid power, innovative technology, and premium features for drivers needing capability and comfort. Outfitted with a 3.5L PowerBoost Full-Hybrid V6, this truck delivers the strength and efficiency modern truck buyers demand.

This truck is ideally suited for drivers who need a reliable workhorse that also provides luxury and tech-savvy amenities. Its combination of interior conveniences like the Interior Work Surface and Twin Panel Moonroof create a comfortable mobile office, while features such as Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Trailer Tow Package make towing and hauling simpler for seasoned professionals and new truck owners alike. Around the rd St. Homewood, IL area, its capability and comfort make it a strong choice for daily commutes, unpredictable Midwest weather, and demanding job requirements.

Performance in the F-150 Lariat centers on the 3.5L PowerBoost Full-Hybrid V6, which balances efficient fuel use with robust acceleration and smooth power delivery. Paired with a responsive automatic transmission, this setup offers seamless transitions between electric and gasoline power, resulting in a quieter cabin and less frequent fuel stops. The hybrid system is particularly useful for drivers who need both strong towing capability and lower operating costs, while the advanced chassis ensures stability and confidence, whether navigating city roads or rural worksites.

Safety in this truck is engineered through the Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0 suite, which enhances driver awareness and reduces stress in real-world conditions. Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control maintains a safe following distance, while the 360 Degree Camera with Trailer Reverse Guidance provides visual support during tricky parking or trailer maneuvers. The integrated Trailer Brake Controller adds an extra layer of control when hauling heavy loads, and features like LED Box Lighting improve visibility after dark, helping avoid mishaps and supporting safer nighttime work.

The Equipment Group 502A High brings a host of comfort and technology features, including Connected Built-In Navigation and the Twin Panel Moonroof for an upscale driving environment. The Bed Utility Package, with its BoxLink and Tailgate Step with Work Surface, is designed for practical cargo management and ease of access. The Lariat Sport Appearance Package delivers a unique interior, body-color bumpers, and chrome exhaust, elevating both style and comfort. These packages collectively ensure the F-150 Lariat is ready for both professional and personal demands.

When compared to other full-size trucks like the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and Ram 1500, the F-150 Lariat stands out with its hybrid powertrain and broad suite of advanced technology.

Key features of this truck include the 3.5L PowerBoost Full-Hybrid V6, Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0, Pro Trailer Backup Assist, Connected Built-In Navigation, and a Twin Panel Moonroof. In daily driving, the hybrid powertrain ensures strong acceleration and reduced fuel usage, while the Interior Work Surface transforms the cabin into a workspace. Safety systems like Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control and the 360 Degree Camera add peace of mind.

Ford of Homewood welcomes you to experience the 2023 F-150 Lariat in person. For more information or to schedule a test drive, visit us at 3233 183rd St. Homewood, IL 60430 or call 708-356-9308. Our team is ready to help you make a confident, informed decision about your next truck.

Factory off-road suspension, front Torsen differential, locking rear axle, Tremor-specific styling, upgraded approach angles, unique wheels and tires, and genuine trail capabilityall while maintaining the towing, payload, and everyday usability that make an F-150 such a strong daily driver.This one was ordered exceptionally well.The 402A High Package added the 360-degree camera system, wireless charging, LED mirror spotlights, power-sliding rear window, and Tremor-specific upgrades. Then it picked up the Trailer Tow Package, integrated trailer brake controller, B&O audio system, Bed Utility Package, power tailgate, tailgate step, BoxLink system, LED box lighting, connected navigation, and front Torsen differential. Original MSRP exceeded $72,000.It's hard to find a meaningful option missing from this truck.And the Tremor matters.Most lifted trucks on the market started life as standard pickups that somebody modified later. That's a very different ownership experience.What also stands out is the ownership history.CARFAX shows a 1-owner Illinois truck with documented maintenance history, regular oil changes, air filter service, cabin filter replacements, and ongoing maintenance throughout ownership.Now let's address the history honestly.CARFAX reflects minor damage reported in August 2024. The report specifically classifies the event as minor damage, with no structural damage reported and no airbag deployment.In today's market, trucks like this create an interesting value equation.A new Tremor similarly equipped pushes deep into premium truck pricing very quickly. Once you add the 402A package, towing equipment, Bed Utility Package, B&O audio, cameras, and Tremor-specific hardware, the replacement cost becomes substantial. That's exactly why clean used Tremors continue attracting attention from buyers who want the capability without writing a new-truck check.This vehicle also reflects an open Ford recall related to trailer module software programming. The 2023 Ford F-150 Lariat immediately stands out among pickup trucks like the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and Ram 1500 by blending power, advanced towing tech, and upscale comfort in a single package. Its 3.5L V6 EcoBoost engine with 4WD, EPA-estimated 18 city/23 highway MPG, and a suite of luxury features give this truck a decisive edge for drivers seeking capability without sacrificing refinement.

Drivers comparing multiple trucks will find the F-150 Lariat a top choice for daily work, weekend hauling, and family comfort. Its Max Trailer Tow Package and Bed Utility Package give it clear practical advantages when towing trailers, boats, or handling jobsite gear. The Twin Panel Moonroof and ventilated front seats create a high-value cabin experience, making it ideal for those in rd St. Homewood, IL who want a truck that's ready for Midwest weather and long commutes while still delivering premium amenities.

Performance-wise, while competitors often emphasize V8 options or basic turbo engines, this truck's 3.5L V6 EcoBoost delivers smooth, strong acceleration and confident towing. The 10-Speed Automatic transmission ensures seamless shifts whether you're merging on the highway or backing into a tight loading dock. Advanced features like Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist—part of the Max Trailer Tow Package—make maneuvering heavy loads easier than with most rivals, reducing stress for less-experienced haulers.

In terms of safety, the F-150 Lariat provides peace of mind with standard Ford BlueCruise 1.0 for hands-free driving, a feature that is often optional or unavailable on other trucks in this class. Rain-Sensing Wipers and LED Projector Headlamps with Dynamic Bending enhance visibility in all conditions. The Integrated Trailer Brake Controller adds confidence when towing, while basics like ABS and advanced camera systems support safer maneuvering in crowded lots or on busy roads.

Key features like the Power Tailgate and Tailgate Step with Work Surface simplify everyday loading and unloading tasks. The Extended Range 36-Gallon Fuel Tank means fewer stops on long drives, while the Wireless Charging Pad supports device connectivity on the go. The BoxLink system and LED Box Lighting provide versatile cargo solutions, making this truck as comfortable at a campsite as it is at a jobsite. Equipment Group 502A High unifies these features for a premium ownership experience.

Compared to the Chevrolet Silverado 1500 and Ram 1500, the F-150 Lariat distinguishes itself by including advanced towing aids and luxury touches as standard—features that often cost extra on rivals. This makes it a better value for buyers prioritizing both capability and comfort. While other trucks may match it in base towing or payload, few deliver the same combination of refined interior, advanced tech, and all-around versatility in a single package.

Choosing the F-150 Lariat over its peers means getting standard features like BlueCruise 1.0 and Pro Trailer Backup Assist, which streamline highway drives and tricky trailer maneuvers. Buyers often ask which truck best balances daily comfort with worksite utility, this truck's heated second row, ventilated front seats, and tailored towing technology provide a stronger combination than competitors. For those who want a truck that feels at home both at work and on family adventures, the F-150 Lariat's feature set and driving experience make it the segment's smart buy.

To experience the difference firsthand, visit Ford of Homewood at 3233 183rd St. Homewood, IL 60430 or call 708-356-9308. The team is ready to answer your questions, show you the F-150 Lariat's unique features, and help you make an informed choice among today's leading pickups.
